attributes.description: Number of incoming Bill of Materials Links of a given material | plant. Indicates the number BOM line items that contribute to producing this material | plant.
attributes.displayName: No. of Incoming Bill of Material Links
attributes.pql:
COALESCE(
  PU_FIRST(
    "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant",
    CASE WHEN LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") = "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"
    THEN
    BIND(
      COMMON_TABLE(LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"), "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"),
      PU_COUNT(
        DOMAIN_TABLE ( LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") ),
        LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"),
        LINK_ATTRIBUTES("o_celonis_RelationshipBillOfMaterials"."ID") IS NOT NULL
        AND LINK_SOURCE("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") != LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID")
      )
    )
    END
  ), 0
)

        AND LINK_SOURCE("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") != LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID")

    )

) = 0
     AND COALESCE(

  THEN
  BIND(
    COMMON_TABLE(LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"), "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"),

     AND PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_PurchaseScheduleLine"."ID") > 0
  THEN 1
END IS NOT NULL),
    END (CASE
  WHEN COALESCE(
  PU_FIRST(
    "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant",
    CASE WHEN LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") = "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"
    THEN
    BIND(
      COMMON_TABLE(LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"), "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"),
      PU_COUNT(
        DOMAIN_TABLE ( LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") ),
        LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"),
        LINK_ATTRIBUTES("o_celonis_RelationshipBillOfMaterials"."ID") IS NOT NULL
        AND LINK_SOURCE("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") != LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID")
      )
    )
    END
  ), 0
) > 0
    AND COALESCE(
  PU_FIRST(
  "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant",
  CASE WHEN LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") = "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"
  THEN
  BIND(
    COMMON_TABLE(LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"), "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID"),
    PU_COUNT(
      DOMAIN_TABLE ( LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID")),

      LINK_TARGET("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID") = LINK_SOURCE("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ID")

  )
  END
), 0) = 0
    AND PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_SalesOrderScheduleLine"."ID") > 0
  THEN 1
END IS NOT NULL),
    ALL (CASE
  WHEN GREATEST(
    PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."ID"),
    PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_PurchaseScheduleLine"."ID"),

    PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_PlannedSupply"."ID"),
    PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_MaterialReservation"."ID"),
    PU_COUNT("o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant", "o_celonis_MaterialRequirement"."ID")
  ) > 0
  THEN 1

attributes.description: Combined result of ABC and XYZ analyses for Material-Plant. For more detailed definitions see the respective KPIs for ABC and XYZ classification.
Helper KPI to pick a z-value from the standard normal distribution based on desired service level for the computation of the Safety Stock recommendation.
Planned service level for a Material-Plant combination. This KPI computes a potential Service level based on the outcome of XYZ classification.
Replenishment Lead time Standard Deviation per Material-Plant, considering both production and Purchase based on either average or median.
attributes.pql:
WITH[
  REGISTER @MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__PurchaseLeadTime AS 
    SQRT(
      1
      /
      PU_COUNT(
        "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
        ,BIND(
          "o_celonis_PurchaseScheduleLine"
          ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."ID"
        )
        , ISNULL("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."ActualLeadTime") = 0
        AND (
          ROUND(
            MONTHS_BETWEEN(
              ROUND_MONTH(
                "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate" 
              )
              ,ROUND_MONTH(
                TODAY()
              )
            )
          ) BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths})
        )
        *
        PU_SUM(
          "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
          ,BIND(
            "o_celonis_PurchaseScheduleLine"
            ,SQUARE(
              "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."ActualLeadTime"
              -
              PU_AVG(
                "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
                ,BIND(
                  "o_celonis_PurchaseScheduleLine"
                  ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."ActualLeadTime"
                )
                ,(ROUND(
                  MONTHS_BETWEEN(
                    ROUND_MONTH(
                      "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate" 
                    )
                    ,ROUND_MONTH(
                      TODAY()
                    )
                  )
                ) BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths})
              )
            )
          )
          ,(ROUND(
            MONTHS_BETWEEN(
              ROUND_MONTH(
                "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate" 
              )
              ,ROUND_MONTH(
                TODAY()
              )
            )
          ) BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths})
        )
              
              )
            ,REGISTER @MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__ProductionLeadTime AS
              SQRT(
                1
                /
                PU_COUNT(
                  "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
                  ,"o_celonis_ProductionOrder"."ID"
                  , ISNULL("O_CELONIS_ProductionOrder"."ActualLeadTime") = 0
                  AND ("o_celonis_ProductionOrder"."MonthsSinceActualFinish" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths})
                )
                *
                PU_SUM(
                  "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
                  ,SQUARE(
                    "O_CELONIS_ProductionOrder"."ActualLeadTime"
                    -
                    PU_AVG(
                      "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
                      ,BIND( "o_celonis_ProductionOrder"
                      ,"O_CELONIS_ProductionOrder"."ActualLeadTime" )
                      ,("o_celonis_ProductionOrder"."MonthsSinceActualFinish" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths})
                    )
                  ),("o_celonis_ProductionOrder"."MonthsSinceActualFinish" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths})
                )
              )
          ]
          CASE   
            WHEN "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ProcurementType" = 'External Procurement'
            THEN @MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__PurchaseLeadTime
            WHEN "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ProcurementType" = 'In-house Production'
            THEN @MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__ProductionLeadTime
            WHEN "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ProcurementType" = 'Both Procurement Types' 
            THEN (
              COALESCE(@MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__PurchaseLeadTime,@MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__ProductionLeadTime)
              + COALESCE(@MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__ProductionLeadTime,@MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__PurchaseLeadTime)
            )/2
            WHEN "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"."ProcurementType" IS NULL
            THEN    
              LEAST(
                @MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__PurchaseLeadTime
                ,@MaterialMasterPlant_STDEV__ProductionLeadTime
              ) 
            ELSE NULL
          END

attributes.description: ABC-classification of all materials based on consumption value. Materials making up 80% of a company's consumption value are classified as A, the next 15% as B, and remaining materials as C. Materials without consumption data are considered Unclassified.
attributes.pql:
WITH[
  REGISTER @MaterialMasterPlant_RunningConsumptionAmountConverted AS 
    RUNNING_SUM(
      PU_SUM(
        "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
        ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."NetAmountConverted"
        ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."IsConsumptionRelevant" = 'Relevant' AND
        "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MovementDirection" = 'Outgoing' AND
        "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MonthsSinceCreationTime" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths}
      )
      ,ORDER BY (
        PU_SUM(
          "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
          ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."NetAmountConverted"
          ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."IsConsumptionRelevant" = 'Relevant' AND
          "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MovementDirection" = 'Outgoing' AND
          "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MonthsSinceCreationTime" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths}
        ) DESC
      )
      ,PARTITION BY ("o_celonis_Plant"."ID")
    )
  ,REGISTER @Plant_ConsumptionAmountConverted AS 
    PU_SUM(
      "o_celonis_Plant"
      ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."NetAmountConverted"
      ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."IsConsumptionRelevant" = 'Relevant' AND
      "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MovementDirection" = 'Outgoing' AND
      "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MonthsSinceCreationTime" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths}
    )
]
CASE 
  WHEN 
    ISNULL(
      PU_SUM(
        "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
        ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."NetAmountConverted"
        ,"o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."IsConsumptionRelevant" = 'Relevant' AND
        "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MovementDirection" = 'Outgoing' AND
        "o_celonis_MaterialMovement"."MonthsSinceCreationTime" BETWEEN 1 AND ${im_consideredpastmonths}
      )
    ) = 1
  THEN NULL
  WHEN 
    @MaterialMasterPlant_RunningConsumptionAmountConverted <= 0.8 * @Plant_ConsumptionAmountConverted
  THEN 'A'
  WHEN 
    @MaterialMasterPlant_RunningConsumptionAmountConverted <= 0.95 * @Plant_ConsumptionAmountConverted
  THEN 'B'
  ELSE 'C'
END

Converted Inventory on Hand Quantity

attributes.pql:
COALESCE(PU_SUM ( 
  "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
  ,"o_celonis_PlannedSupply"."OrderQuantityConverted" - "o_celonis_PlannedSupply"."AdjustmentQuantityConverted"
  ,("o_celonis_PlannedSupply"."OrderFinishDate" BETWEEN TODAY() AND ADD_MONTHS(TODAY(), ${im_consideredfuturemonths})) AND "o_celonis_PlannedSupply"."IsOpen" = 'Open'
),0.0)

COALESCE(PU_SUM ( 
  "o_celonis_MaterialMasterPlant"
  ,"o_celonis_PurchaseRequisitionLine"."QuantityConverted" 
  ,"o_celonis_PurchaseRequisitionLine"."IsOpen" = 'Open' AND ("o_celonis_PurchaseRequisitionLine"."ExpectedDeliveryDate" BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(TODAY(), (-1)*${im_consideredpastmonths}) AND ADD_MONTHS(TODAY(), ${im_consideredfuturemonths}))
),0.0)

Indicates whether a Purchase Document was received on time. The KPI is negatively impacted by early (tolerance: ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineisearlyindays} days) and late (tolerance: ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineislateindays} days) deliveries.
attributes.pql:
CASE
  WHEN ISNULL("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate") = 1 THEN 'NO_DATE'
  WHEN ISNULL("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate") = 1 AND DAYS_BETWEEN("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate",TODAY()) <= 0 THEN 'NO_GR_AND_FUTURE_DUE_DATE'
  WHEN ISNULL("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate") = 1 AND DAYS_BETWEEN("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate",TODAY()) > 0 AND DAYS_BETWEEN("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate",TODAY()) <= ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineisearlyindays}
  THEN 'NO_GR_PASSED_DUE_DATE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE'
  WHEN ISNULL("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate") = 1 AND DAYS_BETWEEN("o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate",TODAY()) > ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineislateindays}
  THEN 'NO_GR_PASSED_DUE_DATE_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE'
  WHEN
    ROUND(DAYS_BETWEEN(
    "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate"
    ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate"))
    > ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineisearlyindays}
  THEN 'EARLY'
  WHEN
    ROUND(
      DAYS_BETWEEN(
        "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate"
        ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate"
      )
    )
    >= 0.0
    AND
    ROUND(
      DAYS_BETWEEN(
        "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate"
        ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate"
      )
    )
    <= ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineisearlyindays}
  THEN 'ON_TIME_BEFORE_DUE_DATE'
  WHEN
    ROUND(
      DAYS_BETWEEN(
        "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate"
        ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate"
      )
    )
    <= 0.0
    AND
    ROUND(
      DAYS_BETWEEN(
        "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."GoodsReceiptDate"
        ,"o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."LineDeliveryDate"
      )
    )
    >= ${im_graceperiodpurchasedocumentlineislateindays} * (-1.0)
    THEN 'ON_TIME_AFTER_DUE_DATE'
  ELSE 'LATE'
END

CASE
  WHEN
    "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."PurchaseDocumentReceivedOutcomes" IN ('LATE', 'NO_GR_PASSED_DUE_DATE_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE')
  THEN 1
  WHEN
    "o_celonis_PurchaseDocumentLine"."PurchaseDocumentReceivedOutcomes" IN ('ON_TIME_AFTER_DUE_DATE', 'ON_TIME_BEFORE_DUE_DATE', 'EARLY')
  THEN 0
  ELSE NULL
END
